turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two different friends invited me to things on Saturday night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Popular weekend. Is it a choice between a big party and something smaller, or are they both similar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One's a birthday party, the other is a quiet dinner.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Which one would you be more disappointed to miss?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you keep it down a bit tomorrow morning? I'm trying to sleep in.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. What time do you want to get up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ten, maybe eleven. It's been such a long week.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No problem. I'll make my coffee quietly and go for a walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're the best. Could you close the hallway door too? The light comes in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. You were choosing between the party and the dinner on Saturday.
